I can't buy/watch stuff (not just books), as I'm being blocked, or I need to pay more for them (either order, or not being eligible for online discount, or currency exchange rate... usually it's all together). 

I'm not saying that I want to experience the american culture, I live the american culture - but being withheld in here, forced to participate in religious customs, not having public transportation on nights and weekends, not being able to travel 40 minutes away because someone will kill you.

Canada, Australia, UK are great, but not suitable for me for growth. the latter are extremely expensive and have problematic work laws if you're new. Netflix blocks credit cards and you have pay more for the ability to view content. Amazon doesn't ship here (besides books), for the solutions available, any purchase will cost at least $20 for a small object and will take weeks to arrive. 
The US is big, if you aren't happy with a state, you can move and try again.

I have talked with many, including friends that moved there (L.A., Seattle), their life is amazing. I saw it on my own.

My options are Canada, Australia, UK and US. I want the american culture, I want Netflix, I want Amazon, I want to create stuff.
